description_en: Queries alert events on the security dashboard
description_zh: 查询安全大屏告警事件
name: DescribeScreenAlarmEventList

parameters.help_en:
The language of the request and response. Valid values:  
zh: Chinese
en: English
parameters.help_zh:
请求和接收消息的语言类型。取值：  
zh：中文
en：英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the alert events to query have been handled. Valid values:
N: not handled
Y: handled
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的告警事件是否已处理。取值：
N：未处理
Y：已处理
parameters.name: dealed

parameters.help_en: The source of the request. Set the value to sas, which indicates that the request is from Security Center
parameters.help_zh: 请求来源标识，固定为sas，表示请求来源为云安全中心
parameters.name: from

parameters.help_en:
The severity levels of the alert events to query. Separate multiple severity levels with commas (,). The severity levels are listed in descending order. Valid values:
serious: urgent
suspicious: suspicious
remind: reminder
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的告警事件处理的紧急程度，多个紧急程度之间使用半角逗号（,）分隔，紧急程度依次递减。取值：
serious：紧急
suspicious：可疑
remind：提醒
parameters.name: levels

parameters.help_en: The alert name or asset information to query
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的告警名称或资产信息
parameters.name: remark

parameters.help_en: The name of the alert event to query
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的告警事件的告警名称
parameters.name: alarm_event_name

parameters.help_en: The type of the alert event to query
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的告警事件的类型
parameters.name: alarm_event_type

parameters.help_en: The page number of the current page in a paged query. Minimum value: 1. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时，显示的当前页的页码。起始值为1，默认值为1
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page in a paged query. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时，每页显示的漏洞的数量。默认值为10，表示每页显示10条漏洞
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The start of the time range during which the alert event last occurred
parameters.help_zh: 最新发生时间起始时间
parameters.name: time_start

parameters.help_en: The end of the time range during which the alert event last occurred
parameters.help_zh: 最新发生时间结束时间
parameters.name: time_end

Count.description_en: The number of entries on the current page
Count.description_zh: 当前页显示的资产的条数

CurrentPage.description_en: The page number of the current page in a paged query
CurrentPage.description_zh: 分页查询时，当前页的页码

PageSize.description_en: The maximum number of entries per page in a paged query
PageSize.description_zh: 分页查询时，每页最多显示的数据条数

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, which is a unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request. You can use this ID to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题

items.description_en: The details of the alert event

AlarmEventName.description_en: The name of the alert event
AlarmEventName.example: 疑似对外发起登录扫描活动

AlarmEventType.description_en: The type of the alert event

AlarmUniqueInfo.description_en: The unique ID of the alert event

CanBeDealOnLine.description_en:
Indicates whether the alert event can be handled online, such as quarantine. Valid values:

true: can be handled online
false: cannot be handled online
CanBeDealOnLine.description_zh:
是否支持在线处理告警事件，例如隔离。取值包括：

true：支持在线处理
false：不支持在线处理

CanCancelFault.description_en:
Indicates whether the alert event can be unmarked as a false positive. Valid values:

true: can be unmarked
false: cannot be unmarked
CanCancelFault.description_zh:
告警事件能否取消标记为误报。取值：

true：可以取消
false：不可以取消

DataSource.description_en: The data source of the alert event

Dealed.description_en:
Indicates whether the alert event has been handled. Valid values:

true: handled
false: pending
Dealed.description_zh:
告警事件是否已处理。取值：

true：已处理
false：待处理

Description.description_en: The description of the alert event

EndTime.description_en: The timestamp when the alert event last occurred. Unit: milliseconds
EndTime.description_zh: 告警事件最新发生的时间戳。单位为毫秒

InstanceName.description_en: The name of the asset instance affected by the alert event
InstanceName.description_zh: 受告警事件影响资产实例的名称

InternetIp.description_en: The public IP address of the asset instance affected by the alert event
InternetIp.description_zh: 受告警事件影响的资产实例的公网IP

IntranetIp.description_en: The private IP address of the associated instance

Level.description_en:
The severity level of the alert event. Valid values:
serious: urgent
suspicious: suspicious
remind: reminder
Level.description_zh:
告警事件的危险等级。取值：
serious：紧急
suspicious：可疑
remind：提醒

SaleVersion.description_en:
The edition of the product that supports the alert event detection. Valid values:
0: Basic edition
1: Enterprise edition
SaleVersion.description_zh:
告警事件检测支持的产品售卖版本。取值包括：
0：基础版本
1：企业版本

Solution.description_en: The solution for the alert event
Solution.example: {'Type': 'text', 'Value': 'Enter NAS console - monitoring and auditing - log analysis - log management - new log dump to create a log recording service for the file system.'}

StartTime.description_en: The timestamp when the alert event started. Unit: milliseconds
StartTime.description_zh: 告警事件的开始时间戳，单位为毫秒

SuspiciousEventCount.description_en: The number of alert events associated with the alert event
SuspiciousEventCount.description_zh: 告警事件关联的告警事件的条数

Uuid.description_en: The unique identifier of the instance associated with the alert event
Uuid.description_zh: 告警事件关联的实例的唯一标识
